description: The bar chart compares the performance of three models—DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—on two evaluation metrics: Recall and F1 Score. The horizontal axis displays the two metrics, while the vertical axis represents the score values, ranging from 40 to 100. For the Recall metric, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) model achieves a score of 63.58, TA-SQL (zero-shot) achieves 71.90, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) achieves 72.29. For the F1 Score metric, the scores are 75.34 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 80.40 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 81.08 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The chart shows that the DIN-SQL (few-shot) model consistently outperforms the other two models on both metrics, with the highest F1 Score of 81.08. The TA-SQL (zero-shot) model performs better than DIN-SQL (zero-shot) on both metrics, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) model shows a significant improvement over its zero-shot counterpart.
